card.name: Activist text on water and solidarity
card.fires_on: Mostly words inside activist or political texts about water privatization, Latin American groups and international bodies, such as 'of' after 'experiences' or 'Committee' in an organization name. It also fires on odd spots like partway through a foreign name or a URL.

modes.label: Campaign and organization names
modes.description: Words within names of social movements, treaties and alliances in water-justice and trade-opposition writing.
modes.example: Hemispheric Social Alliance International<< Committee>> for a Global Water Treaty

modes.label: Linking words in campaign lists
modes.description: Small words like 'of' in bulleted action items about sharing experiences and building funds or networks.
modes.example: - To share experiences<< of>> establishing solidarity funds for financing models of public

modes.label: Broken-up names and links
modes.description: Partway through foreign names, quotation marks or web addresses.
modes.example: The OCI encouraged the Bolivian Part<<ido>> Obrero Revolucionario (POR)
